headline: Reuters reports Project Jupiter loan pricing pressure amid stalled debt distribution
summary: Reuters reported on 18 September 2026, citing the Financial Times, that roughly $18 billion in loans tied to Oracle-leased Project Jupiter in New Mexico were quoted at 89–91 cents on the dollar by syndicate banks, while efforts to distribute the debt more broadly had stalled. The report links lender concerns to local opposition and Oracle’s rising borrowing. This is an attributed market signal, not confirmation of completed loan sales, realized losses, default, or project cancellation.
